notes: The accounts of the Wazuh indexer that this repository holds (kubernetes/apps/security/wazuh/README.md, 'Accounts'). The job makes each role, each user and each role mapping here, and changes one when it differs. It never changes a reserved, hidden or static resource, and never a user or role that is not in this file.
Each user's password is a file of a Secret that the owner makes (password_file). The job sets it when the user can not log in with it, and never prints it.

Open decision, at the design gate: the account step runs as a user of its own (tnwks-accounts, mapped by the owner to security_rest_api_access), and the settings step as tnwks-settings, which has no right to the Security API. The simpler form runs both steps as admin.

tnwks-converter reads the index names of the contract (kubernetes/apps/security/wazuh/README.md, 'Contract'). On the agent snapshots it reads only the fields of the agent list (field-level security), not the host address, the system or the groups.

tnwks-settings.description: The settings job: the ISM policies of tnwks, the move of backing indices to them, and the raw events setting.

tnwks-converter.description: The converter: the state of SCA and vulnerabilities, the agent list, and the state of the content feed. No event, no inventory, no file integrity.
